ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is labeled "Xijiang shipping trunk line." Along the river channel from Baise, Tianyang, Tiandong, Pingguo, Jinji, Nanning City, Hengxian, Guigang to the Guiping area, multiple ship lock or hub symbols are densely distributed on the river line. Reasoning: The question stem points out that only after the ship locks were officially opened to navigation did the Xijiang trunk line gradually become a "water expressway." The function of ship locks is to help ships overcome the water level difference between upstream and downstream and realize continuous navigation. Therefore, it can be inferred in reverse that before the ship locks were built, the main natural reason limiting the shipping capacity of the Xijiang trunk line was that the drop between the upstream and downstream of the river was relatively large.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中西江干线沿线密集分布的船闸/枢纽符号，再结合题干“船闸正式通航后才逐渐成为水上高速公路”，判断船闸解决的是船舶跨越上下游水位差的问题。由此反推船闸建成前的主要限制因素是河流落差大。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中标注为“西江航运干线”，沿河道从百色、田阳、田东、平果、金鸡、南宁市、横县、贵港到桂平一带，河流线上密集分布着多个船闸或枢纽符号。推理：题干指出船闸正式通航后，西江干线才逐渐成为“水上高速公路”。船闸的作用是帮助船舶克服上下游水位差，实现连续通航。因此可反推，船闸建成前限制西江干线航运能力的主要自然原因，是河流上下游落差较大。

raw_record.answer: The river has a large drop.
